Where access or image quality still prevents confirmation, leave the status as unresolved. The accuracy of the record matters more than reaching a confident conclusion from an ambiguous view.
corrections.translation: 配件可见但认不清时，以位置和外观描述。包后方的一条黑色细条可能是提手、肩带，也可能只是包装带。拍到固定扣或全长，往往比继续放大局部更能确认身份。尚未辨清前，先保留几种有根据的可能。

corrections.source: Handle accessories packed separately
corrections.translation: 处理卖家分开发的配件

corrections.source: A seller might send more than one parcel for a purchase. Before assuming a component has been omitted, check the records the order shows for expected domestic deliveries and warehouse intake. Distinguish a seller message saying an item will follow from a shipment reference or intake entry that actually identifies it. If a second package exists, record the reference and what it is expected to contain. Keep the purchase open for the outstanding component until you can evaluate the evidence relevant to your decision.
corrections.translation: 一笔交易可能由卖家分多个包裹发出。推断漏发以前，先查看预计国内来件与仓库入库记录。区分“稍后补发”的消息和能对应到该配件的运单或入库凭证。如果确有第二包，记下编号和预计内容，证据不足时保持待处理状态。

corrections.source: A second domestic tracking event also does not prove the missing accessory is inside. The event identifies movement of a package. The received contents require a corresponding intake record or confirmation. For a bag with a detachable chain strap, you might note that the main bag arrived on one date and the seller described a separate parcel for the chain on another date. Link the second intake to the purchase only once the order record or support response gives you a basis to do so.
corrections.translation: 第二条国内物流轨迹也只能说明有包裹移动，并不能证明缺的配件就在里面。带可拆链条肩带的包，可分别记主包到仓日期和卖家说链条另寄的日期。等订单记录或客服确认能把第二次入库与原购买对应起来，再正式关联。

corrections.source: Ask for a specific next action
corrections.translation: 明确请对方下一步做什么

corrections.source: A useful message includes the selected option, the privately supplied order reference, the component expected and the evidence currently available. You might write that the paid selection says bag with long strap, the overview shows the bag closed and the strap is not visible. Ask whether someone can check inside the bag and confirm the strap before dispatch. This describes a gap and requests a specific action without accusing the seller or warehouse of losing an item.
corrections.translation: 把私下提供的订单号、所选规格、预计配件和已有证据放在一起。例如“付款选项为包加长肩带，目前总览中包是拉上的，看不到肩带，能否打开检查？”这种描述既指出为什么无法确认，也让经手人清楚应查看哪里。

corrections.source: If support confirms the item was absent, ask which resolution options apply to this order and whether each one involves a deadline, charge or separate shipment. A replacement accessory, a seller inquiry and a return can have different consequences. Record what you actually request and any confirmation received. Avoid combining the missing-strap question with unrelated complaints about colour or packaging in one long paragraph. Separate observations make it easier to see which issues have been addressed and which remain open.
corrections.translation: 如果客服确认缺件，询问本单有哪些补救方案，是否有期限、费用或另寄安排。补发配件、向卖家核实和退货会有不同后果。记录卖家或客服实际提供的办法及你接受的选择，尚未获准的方案不能视为已落实。

corrections.source: Close the record with evidence of the outcome
corrections.translation: 以实际处理结果结案

corrections.source: A promise to send an accessory resolves the seller's intended next step. The actual shortage remains open until the promised item arrives or you accept another resolution. Keep the follow-up intake, photograph or adjustment alongside the original order. If an adjustment is offered, record the amount, currency and scope in the private order notes. A statement about one accessory does not automatically explain other charges or establish a general policy for future orders.
corrections.translation: 承诺补发只说明卖家准备做什么。直到补件到达，或你接受了其他处理方式，缺件问题仍待解决。将后续入库、照片或金额调整与原订单放在一起。如果实收的补件不同，留存差异并继续核实。

corrections.source: At the packing stage, check that the final parcel request still includes every warehouse item needed for the complete set. If a replacement strap has a separate warehouse reference, attach or select it as the current interface requires. If support says it was already placed inside the bag, save that confirmation. A precise final note can be very short: the black long strap arrived separately, the clips are visible in the new image, and the bag and strap now belong to the same intended parcel.
corrections.translation: 准备国际寄送时，检查最终选中的入库项目是否凑齐整套。若补发肩带有独立入库号，依当前界面的要求一起选择或关联。如果客服说明已把肩带并回主包，保留该确认；不要重复选中同一件，也不要只因主包已选就漏掉补件。

corrections.source: A useful request tells a person holding the item what to photograph, how to position it and which question the resulting frame should answer.
corrections.translation: 有用的拍照请求要让拿着实物的人知道拍什么、怎样摆、照片应该回答哪个问题。

corrections.source: Write the decision first
corrections.translation: 先说明结果会影响哪项决定

corrections.source: Explain what changes depending on the result. You might need to decide whether a jacket has a two-way zipper, whether a printed name is spelled correctly, or whether a sleeve is long enough. The phrase more pictures leaves the photographer to choose an angle. Starting with the decision helps you ask for one informative view rather than several attractive views that repeat the original gallery.
corrections.translation: 你可能想确认夹克是否双向拉链、定制名字有无拼错，或袖长是否够用。“多拍几张”没有说明目的。先写清决定，再选能解决问题的角度，让经手人知道什么样的图就算完成请求。

corrections.source: Identify the object unambiguously
corrections.translation: 明确指向正确的物件

corrections.source: Give the item or order reference and exact option. When two navy jackets differ only in size, a colour name is insufficient. Ask that the item remains identifiable in the picture. For a personalisation check, provide the exact text from the order and specify whether front, back or sleeve should be visible. Avoid including unrelated personal or payment information in the request.
corrections.translation: 提供商品或订单编号和确切规格。两件深蓝夹克若只差尺码，单写“蓝色”不够。要求照片保留辨认商品的线索。查定制文字时，给出原本应印的准确拼写，才能逐字对照。

corrections.source: Specify composition and endpoints
corrections.translation: 指明构图与测量端点

corrections.source: Check the response against the question
corrections.translation: 检查回复是否回答了原问题

corrections.source: Look at the requested feature before scanning the rest of the photograph. Can you see both endpoints? Is the label readable? Is the unit laid flat, or held at an angle that distorts the apparent length? If the image leaves a gap, describe that gap in a follow-up. Asking for the lower slider to be visible is more actionable than saying that the first picture was bad.
corrections.translation: 先检查要求拍摄的部位：两端是否都可见？标签能否读清？衣服是否平铺，还是倾斜导致长度看起来不同？若仍有缺口，准确指出缺什么。若照片已经回答问题，就保存原图，不必重拍相同角度。

corrections.source: Budget the service and retain the result
corrections.translation: 确认服务费用并保留结果

corrections.source: Check availability, fees and processing information in the current KakoBuy order flow. A third-party article can suggest useful angles, but the conditions attached to your own order decide which request can be fulfilled. Once the image arrives, keep it with the original request and the decision you made. A dated note explaining the accepted measurement remains useful if the item later becomes part of a multi-item parcel.
corrections.translation: 在 KakoBuy 的当前订单界面查看能否申请、怎样收费及处理方式。第三方文章可以提供拍摄角度的思路，实际能做什么取决于这笔订单的条件。照片到了，与原请求和最终决定一起保存。注明日期以及你接受的实测尺寸，以后合箱时还能追溯。

corrections.source: Write the question before selecting the view
corrections.translation: 用一句话明确拍摄目的

corrections.source: Begin by finishing a sentence such as “I need this photo to decide whether the folder will fit inside the sleeve.” A question with a concrete decision helps you choose the subject, angle and reference point. If the sleeve opens along one edge, the useful view might show the clear opening between the two zipper stops. A photo of the entire bag laid beside a ruler can look informative while leaving that exact opening hidden by the zipper or by folded fabric.
corrections.translation: 例如“我要根据这张图判断文件夹能否放入保护套”。有了具体决定，就知道拍哪个物件、什么角度和参照点。若套子一边用拉链开合，有用的可能是两端限位之间的净开口。一张全包放在尺子旁的照片看似详尽，却可能被拉链或折布遮住关键间隙。

corrections.source: An item can invite many interesting close-ups. Prioritise the one detail that determines whether you will accept it. For a garment bought for layering, the flat chest width may be more important than a logo close-up. For a bag bought to replace a lost part, the attachment clip and its inner width may matter most. Use the available gallery to eliminate questions already answered. A focused request takes less interpretation and makes it easier to recognise whether the resulting photo actually satisfies your purpose.
corrections.translation: 同一件货有许多细节都值得看，优先解决决定是否接受的那个。穿在外面叠搭的衣服，平铺胸宽可能比标志特写更重要；包能否装下特定物件时，开口尺寸可能比正面印花更重要。围绕实际用途提出一个清楚的问题。

corrections.source: Describe a location anyone can find
corrections.translation: 用任何人都找得到的位置描述

corrections.source: Use an object and a landmark instead of ambiguous directions. “The inside seam below the left arm when the jacket is worn” identifies a different spot from “the seam on the left of my screen.” Where possible, attach a cropped reference with the area circled and retain a wider view that establishes its location. A close crop of two black seams can be hard to locate on a dark garment. The wide view gives the photographer a way to identify the correct area.
corrections.translation: 用物件和固定部位作参照。“穿上夹克后左腋下方的内侧接缝”，与“我屏幕左边的接缝”指的可能不同。可附一张圈出部位的裁图，再加一张能看出整体位置的图。深色衣服上两条黑缝若只有局部特写，很难让拍摄者找到。

corrections.source: For a pair or a set, name the component as well. A request for the tongue label can produce a clear image of the right shoe while your question concerns the left. If both need checking, say so explicitly and explain what must be readable. A request for a bag buckle should specify which strap and whether the buckle should be shown open, closed or from the inside. Each detail serves an actual comparison and helps avoid a repetition of the existing overview.
corrections.translation: 成双或成套商品还须说明哪一件。只写“请拍鞋舌标”可能收到右鞋，但你问的是左鞋。若两只都要查，请明确写出，并说明需要读清什么；照片命名也要能区分左右和对应订单。

corrections.source: Specify how a measurement should be taken
corrections.translation: 告诉对方具体怎么量

corrections.source: For a flat garment measurement, state the start point, end point and unit. If you want the width across a sweatshirt under the arms, ask to see the garment laid flat, the tape beginning at one underarm seam and ending at the other, with both ends visible. Avoid asking for a fit verdict from a picture. Compare the resulting measurement with a garment you own taken by the same method, and keep any material stretch or garment shape in mind.
corrections.translation: 平铺量衣服时，写清起点、终点和单位。例如要卫衣的腋下宽，请把衣服放平，将皮尺从一侧腋下缝线直量至另一侧，两头同框。不要让照片代替试穿判断；用相同方法量自己的一件衣服作对照，同时考虑面料弹性与版型。

corrections.source: For a small opening, a wide view with both ends of a ruler readable may be more useful than a very tight close-up. A cropped photograph of the number at the far end does not establish the starting point. If a rigid object needs to pass through the opening, distinguish the usable gap from the overall length of the closing hardware. In your note, state which measurement you received. Keep an approximate reading separate from any conclusion about whether the object will fit comfortably.
corrections.translation: 小开口宜用一张能读到尺子两端的照片，未必越近越好。只有终点数字的裁图无法确认起点。硬物要穿过开口时，要看实际净宽，而非整条拉链五金的总长。把收到的实测值记下，再独立判断物件能否顺利放入。

corrections.source: Adapt the request to realistic handling
corrections.translation: 让请求符合仓库实际能做的操作

corrections.source: Some details can be shown by rotating an item. Others require opening packaging, removing a tag or disassembling a component. Identify what the photo would require and check whether the service can perform that action. If it would affect a seal or condition important to your purchase, stop and decide whether the evidence is worth that change. A request to show a manufacturer's printed seal from the outside may answer part of the question with less handling.
corrections.translation: 有些部位转一下商品就能拍，另一些要拆包装、摘标签或拆部件。先弄清需要哪种操作以及服务能否提供。如果会破坏封条或影响你重视的品相，先判断证据是否值得这样做。只拍外侧可见的原厂封条，有时已能回答部分问题。

corrections.source: If the available service offers a priced photo option, check the displayed scope before using it. Confirm whether you are ordering a single image, a requested angle or another defined service. Avoid assuming that adding five unrelated instructions to one message guarantees five separate results. If you have a fixed budget for inspection, choose the detail with the greatest impact on your decision and specify what would count as a readable answer. Save the confirmation with your order evidence.
corrections.translation: 付费加拍前先看服务范围，是一张照片、一个指定角度，还是另一种明确服务？一条消息里塞五个不相干的要求不等于一定会得到五个结果。如果验货预算有限，先拍最能改变决定的那一处，说明怎样才算看清，并把确认信息与订单证据保存。

corrections.source: Evaluate the result and decide whether to follow up
corrections.translation: 看结果决定是否需要再问

corrections.source: Open the original result rather than judging it from a thumbnail. Check three things: whether it is the correct item, whether it shows the specified area and whether the detail is readable or measurable. If it answers your question, write down the observation and date. A concise note such as “zip opening is visible between both stops, measured across the usable gap” preserves the basis of your decision more clearly than a generic acceptance mark.
corrections.translation: 打开原图检视，别只看缩略图。依次确认是不是对应的货、有没有拍到指定位置、细节能否读清或测量。如果已经得出答案，写下观察和日期，例如“能看见拉链两端限位，测量的是中间有效开口”，比只打一个通过勾更容易复查。

corrections.source: If the result misses one requirement, quote that requirement and identify what the image did show. For example, the photograph shows the zipper's total length, while the usable opening between the stops remains hidden. Ask for that specific change only if it still matters to the order. If photography cannot settle the issue, consider the seller's written answer, the available order options or declining the purchase. Repeating the same unanswerable request is unlikely to produce stronger evidence.
corrections.translation: 若只漏了一项，就复述该项并说明图里已有的信息。例如已照出整条拉链长，但看不到两止点间的净开口。仅在这会影响决定时才请补拍。若照片本就解决不了，可参考卖家书面答复、已有选项，或放弃购买；反复要求同样的角度未必能获得新证据。

corrections.source: An exchange creates a second physical unit. Keep the original promise, the original problem and the replacement evidence connected without mixing their identifiers.
corrections.translation: 换货会出现第二件实物。把最初的购买约定、旧货的问题和替换品的照片串起来，但各自的标识要分开，不要混用。

corrections.source: Preserve the starting point
corrections.translation: 保留换货起点

corrections.source: Save the seller option, quantity, price and original order reference. Keep the warehouse photographs that identify the problem. State the issue in terms another person could verify, such as the received size tag reading large when the paid selection was medium. A general statement that the item looks different is harder to act on when the seller page has multiple versions or a changing set of pictures.
corrections.translation: 保存原卖家选项、数量、价格和订单号，留下能说明问题的仓库实拍。用其他人也能核实的说法，例如“订单选 M，收到的尺码标是 L”，而不是只写“不对”。要改选款式时，也应保留最初提交的内容。

corrections.source: Check the available remedy
corrections.translation: 查清实际可用的处理方式

corrections.source: Read the instructions on the actual order and ask what the seller or platform needs before the unit is moved. Note any requirement concerning packaging, tags, evidence or domestic return transport. Avoid assuming that storage time and exchange eligibility have the same deadline. A return agreement, a dispatched return and an accepted replacement are distinct events and may have separate references.
corrections.translation: 阅读该订单的处理说明，移动实物以前先问卖家或平台需要什么。记下关于包装、吊牌、证明资料和国内退回物流的具体要求，不要想当然地认为商品在仓库里就一定还能换。期限、费用或可选方案以本单确认的答复为准。

corrections.source: Record the original unit's movement
corrections.translation: 跟踪原货的去向

corrections.source: Retain the original warehouse entry even after the unit has left. Add the domestic tracking number if one is provided and record who supplied it. A carrier scan tells you about the physical delivery of a package. It cannot, on its own, show that a seller inspected the item, accepted the exchange or sent the replacement. Update each step only when its own evidence appears.
corrections.translation: 旧货离仓后也保留原入库记录。如果拿到国内运单号，记下号码及提供方。承运扫描说明包裹移动，不一定等于卖家验收或新货寄出；把后来每个环节的实际确认分开补入。

corrections.source: Check the replacement without recycling the old pictures
corrections.translation: 替换品使用自己的照片

corrections.source: Give the replacement a separate line with its warehouse intake reference and photographs. Verify the precise detail that prompted the exchange and check the rest of the unit as well. A corrected colour does not establish the right size, quantity or included accessories. When the photographs look identical to the original set, ask which images belong to the new intake before treating them as fresh evidence.
corrections.translation: 为替换品新建一行，保存它自己的入库号与照片。先复核导致换货的具体问题，再按原订单检查其余规格。第一件的清楚照片不能证明新到这件的尺寸、颜色或配件也正确。

corrections.source: Close both the item and payment records
corrections.translation: 同时核清货物与款项

corrections.source: Record any additional charge or credit using the amount, currency and payee actually shown. Match the amounts to the relevant order rather than quietly changing the old price. The item record can be resolved once the replacement has been checked and accepted, even if a separate credit remains pending. Keep both statuses visible to avoid submitting the wrong unit for international packing.
corrections.translation: 将新增收费或退款按界面实际显示的金额、币种和收款方登记，关联到对应订单，不要默默改掉原单价。分别确认替换品是否已接受、差额是否结清。实物问题得到解决并不表示账户中的款项一定已到账。

corrections.source: Define the replacement you would accept
corrections.translation: 先定义什么替代品你愿意收

corrections.source: Before requesting an exchange, write down the exact option that would resolve your problem. If a seller delivered a blue shirt in medium when you ordered navy in medium, the remedy may be the originally selected navy option. If you ordered medium and now decide you want large, describe that as a change of selection. The difference matters because the seller and agent need to understand what happened and what item you would accept. Preserve the original order wording in both situations.
corrections.translation: 换货前写明怎样的规格能解决问题。如果订深蓝 M 却收到蓝色 M，想要的可能仍是原订深蓝 M；若本来订 M，随后自己想要 L，就说明是更改选择。卖家和代购需要分清发生什么、你能接受哪一件。两种情况都保留原订单表述。

corrections.source: Think through alternatives before someone offers a substitute. You might accept a larger size only if a measured chest width falls within a particular range. You might accept the same colour in a different fabric only after seeing the new specification and price. Keep these conditions private until relevant, then state them explicitly when agreeing to a change. A message saying another option is available is a proposal. Record your answer and make sure the order record or later confirmation describes the choice you actually approved.
corrections.translation: 先考虑替代条件，再回答卖家的建议。你可能只在实测胸宽落入某范围时才接受大一码，或某个颜色不能替换。把必需条件与可商量的细节分开；如果还缺数据，先说明要看哪项证据，不要把尚待检查当成无条件同意。

corrections.source: Build the timeline from events
corrections.translation: 以已发生的事件写时间线

corrections.source: Imagine the original garment arrived on Monday. On Tuesday you requested a different size. On Wednesday the agent asked the seller whether that size was in stock. At that point, the exchange has been requested and the seller response is outstanding. An estimate of when a replacement might arrive is not evidence that the original has been sent back or another garment dispatched. Keep the latest confirmed event and the next expected event on separate lines so you can follow up with a precise question.
corrections.translation: 假设周一原衣服入库，周二你要求换尺码，周三代购问卖家新尺码是否有货。这时只能说已申请、待卖家回复。预计新货几时到不等于旧货已寄回或新货已发出。将最后一个已确认的事件和预计下一步分行记录，后续才便于询问。

corrections.source: Useful event fields are date, actor, item or parcel reference, action and evidence. A support reply, tracking event, payment adjustment or new warehouse photograph may each support a different line. Where a time is important, retain the time zone shown in the original record. Do not count an estimate as an elapsed deadline unless the relevant order terms or a support message establish one. If a return or exchange option is time-sensitive, ask support which deadline applies to the specific order.
corrections.translation: 写下日期、经手方、商品或包裹编号、动作及证据。客服回复、物流扫描、金额调整和新入库照片各能证明不同的事。时间重要时保留原记录所示时区。预计日期不能当作已逾期的正式限期；如果换货或退货有时效，请确认适用于这张订单的期限。

corrections.source: Keep outgoing and incoming tracking apart
corrections.translation: 分开追踪退回与补发

corrections.source: An exchange may involve an outgoing domestic parcel and an incoming replacement. They have different directions and can have different tracking references. Label each reference by direction. If an outgoing parcel shows delivered, that event can help establish that a parcel reached its domestic destination. It does not confirm that the seller inspected it, approved a replacement, dispatched the replacement or that the warehouse received the correct size. Ask about the first missing step instead of repeating the entire timeline.
corrections.translation: 换货可能既有从仓库寄回卖家的国内包裹，也有卖家寄往仓库的替换品。方向不同，运单号也可不同。每条记录标清出发方、接收方和实物身份。不要把旧货退回途中的某次扫描当成新货已经到仓。

corrections.source: If a replacement is associated with a new order or warehouse number, connect it to the original using a dated note. Avoid changing the original number to the new one and losing the connection. The original record documents the paid selection and the first unit. The replacement record documents what arrived later. If the replacement is bundled with another item, make sure your note identifies which piece belongs to the exchange and which piece belongs to an unrelated purchase.
corrections.translation: 若替换品取得新订单号或入库号，用带日期的说明与原单关联，而非把旧号改写成新号。过几周查询客服消息、运单和两次照片时，这种关联既能追溯经过，也能区分当前实际在仓的商品。

corrections.source: Follow the money separately
corrections.translation: 金额单独跟踪

corrections.source: A price difference, domestic delivery charge or service charge may be discussed during an exchange. Ask which amounts apply to the offered resolution, which currency they use and whether you need to approve them before work proceeds. A quoted amount is not a payment. Record a charge only when you see the corresponding transaction or confirmation. Likewise, a promised refund and a completed credit may appear on different dates. Tracking the money separately prevents unexplained changes to the item's original purchase price.
corrections.translation: 换货时可能涉及货款差额、国内运费或服务费。确认所提方案实际有哪些费用、使用哪种货币、是否需要先同意。报了价格尚不等于已付款；见到交易或确认后才登记实际支出。承诺退款和到账可能不同日。分开记账可保留最初的买价。

corrections.source: Suppose a seller proposes a more expensive size variant and separately mentions delivery back to the warehouse. Record the item difference and delivery amount as separate fields, even if they later appear as one payment. Check what that payment covers before agreeing. If the transaction appears in another currency, preserve the original amount as well as the amount actually charged. The numbers remain attributable even if your card statement later includes a conversion or a fee outside the seller's quote.
corrections.translation: 假设卖家建议更贵的尺码，还要另收再次寄到仓库的运费。即便最后合并支付，也分别记商品差价和运费，同意前问清覆盖什么。若交易改用另一种货币，保存原币报价和实际扣款。卡账单后来另有换汇或发卡方收费时，仍能追到各金额的来源。

corrections.source: Inspect the replacement as a new unit
corrections.translation: 把替换品当作新到的一件检查

corrections.source: When a new garment arrives, repeat the checks that triggered the exchange. A warehouse status confirming receipt does not tell you whether the new size label or measurement meets your requirement. Compare the replacement against the written agreement and the photos attached to its own intake. If the original problem involved a crooked fastening, inspect that detail on the replacement instead of relying on the original unit's photos. Also confirm the basic option and quantity so a different mistake does not slip through.
corrections.translation: 新衣入库后，重做当初导致换货的检查。状态显示“已签收”不能告诉你新尺码标或实测是否符合要求。使用新入库号配上新照片和已批准的替换选项，并记录决定所依据的具体差异。

corrections.source: Once you have decided, record the result, remaining charges or credits and the warehouse reference intended for international dispatch. Check that the parcel selection uses the accepted replacement. If an old record still appears in your account, do not assume it represents an additional dispatchable item. Ask support which reference corresponds to the unit now held if anything is unclear. A completed timeline ends with a specific accepted item or another confirmed resolution and makes later parcel questions much easier to answer.
corrections.translation: 决定后记下结果、仍要支付或待退的金额，以及实际要提交国际寄送的入库号。检查所选包裹里是已接受的替换品。账户若还显示旧记录，不代表还有第二件可寄；不清楚就问哪个编号对应当前实物。时间线应以明确接受的物件或其他已确认的解决方式结束。

corrections.source: A stable marketplace link can lead to a page whose option wording, photographs or price has changed. Compare dated records before deciding what the change means for your order.
corrections.translation: 同一个商品网址可以一直有效，而选项名称、图片或价格已经变化。先对照不同时点保存的记录，再判断这些改变与自己的订单有什么关系。

corrections.source: Capture a useful snapshot
corrections.translation: 保存能用于核对的快照

corrections.source: Save the seller page with the chosen option visible, the original option text, price, quantity and item ID. Include a date. For a set, make sure the included pieces are stated somewhere in the record. A screenshot of the hero image alone contains little information about which bundle was selected. Keep the agent purchase confirmation separately because it records the choice submitted through the order.
corrections.translation: 保存选中规格清晰可见的商品页、卖家选项原文、价格、数量、商品号和日期。对套装还应保留所选规格明示包含哪些部件。只留一张封面图或不含规格的起售价，后续很难还原当时的要约。

corrections.source: Identify the layer that changed
corrections.translation: 找出变化发生在哪一层

corrections.source: A change in translated wording may occur even when the original seller option is unchanged. Compare original text, option code if available, thumbnail, selected unit and live price. If the whole listing now opens at a different default, select the old option manually before drawing a conclusion. A changed default and a discontinued version call for different decisions.
corrections.translation: 翻译文案可能变化，卖家的原词却没动。对照原文、能找到的规格编码、缩略图、销售单位与当前价格。如果页面只是改了默认选项，先手动选回旧款，再判断原版是否还在售。默认项变化和规格下架需要不同处理。

corrections.source: Reprice an unpaid shortlist entry
corrections.translation: 尚未付款的候选要重新算价

corrections.source: If you have not paid, treat a changed quantity or bundle as a new comparison. Recalculate the unit cost for the included contents, check current stock and review the size chart for the new option. Do not force the old cost into your new shortlist because the listing number is unchanged. If the changed term was the feature you wanted, leave the entry unresolved until the seller confirms it.
corrections.translation: 如果还没付钱，数量或套装变化就作为新方案再比较。按实际包含的物件重算单价，核实库存，查看新选项的尺码表。商品号仍在并不意味着旧价格可以照搬。如果改变的恰是你看中的特性，等卖家确认前保持待核状态。

corrections.source: Compare a paid order to the agreement at payment
corrections.translation: 已付款的订单以购买时约定为准核对

corrections.source: Keep the new listing as evidence of its present state, but compare the received unit with your order-time selection. If your original record said jacket and detachable hood and the current page says jacket only, quote both versions with their dates when asking for a check. The fact that today’s page omits the hood does not independently prove what was selected earlier.
corrections.translation: 保存新页面说明当前状态，再用下单时的规格与到货实物比较。如果原记录写“夹克及可拆帽”，当前只写“夹克”，联系时列出两个版本及各自日期，说明希望检查哪一项。新页面不能代替你当时付款的选项，也尚未证明仓库收到哪一版。

corrections.source: Reassess historical QC references
corrections.translation: 重新评估历史质检照片

corrections.source: An album tied to the same marketplace identifier may show a version sold before the edit. Check the recording date, label, visible construction and package contents. Use it as a guide to the detail worth checking rather than evidence of the new offer. If your own current warehouse pictures become available, connect them to their order and option first and document any specific difference before deciding about shipping.
corrections.translation: 同一平台商品号下的相册可能拍于页面修改前。核对记录日期、标签、能看出的结构和包装内容。利用旧图找出需要确认的细节，不要把它当作新版本的证据。等自己的入库照片出来，先关联订单和选项，具体写明差异，再决定是否寄出。

corrections.source: Save the offer as a dated selection
corrections.translation: 将出品保存为有日期的具体选项

corrections.source: A product link can continue working while its option names, photographs, price or package contents change. If a particular detail determines your choice, save that detail at the time you decide. For a travel pouch, keep the selected option wording, its dimensions, the included strap description and the quantity you are buying. A dated screenshot with the selected option and its price visible can support the note. Crop out private account information when sharing it outside the order support channel.
corrections.translation: 开得了同一个链接，不等于选项、图片、价格和套装内容没变。若某个特征决定你是否买，连同当时选中的规格和日期一起保存。这样回看时知道原笔记讲的是哪一版，而不是把整条出品视为一成不变。

corrections.source: A seller's headline may continue to say “travel pouch with strap” when a newly added option sells the strap alone. Review the selected option and resulting subtotal instead of relying on the headline. If possible, capture both the seller's wording and your working translation. Revisit the selection just before submitting an order, particularly if it has remained in a cart for several days. A previous research note explains why you shortlisted the item; the current selection controls what you are about to submit.
corrections.translation: 主标题也许一直写“带肩带旅行袋”，却后来新增了只卖肩带的选项。要看选中规格和对应小计，不要只看标题或最低价。保存包含所选组件的记录，之后即使默认选项变动也能分清当时买的是包还是单条肩带。

corrections.source: Distinguish a renamed option from a different offer
corrections.translation: 区分选项改名与商品内容改变

corrections.source: Suppose an option once called “olive large” now appears as “green B.” The names alone do not establish whether the products match. Compare the seller's current dimensions, materials, quantity and included components with the original record. If the seller displays an internal option code, compare it as additional evidence, keeping the marketplace item identifier separate. A continuing item identifier establishes the listing reference. The seller may still have changed one or more choices inside that listing.
corrections.translation: 假设原来叫“橄榄绿大号”，现在显示“绿色 B”。光看名字无法确认是否同款。比较当前的尺寸、销售单位、包含物品、图片以及可辨认的规格编码。证据不足时，把新名写成待核关联，别直接把旧笔记改名。

corrections.source: Look for the size chart heading and product diagram associated with the active option. A listing can share one gallery across multiple options, so scrolling past a familiar diagram does not always attach that diagram to your selected version. If the difference matters, ask the seller a question that identifies both old and new wording. A question about whether “green B” currently contains the large pouch and detachable strap gives a clearer target than asking whether the whole page is still the same.
corrections.translation: 查看当前选项对应的尺码表标题和示意图。多个规格可能共用一整套图片，所以滑到一张熟悉的图不能证明选中版本没变。确认单位和测量端点；若页面未说明某张表适用于哪一项，就向卖家询问。

corrections.source: Handle a change before you pay
corrections.translation: 付款之前页面有变怎么办

corrections.source: If you have only shortlisted the product, you can reassess its current terms without reconstructing an order dispute. Record the new option as a fresh observation, compare it with your original requirement and decide whether to keep it on your list. If the new selling unit is one pouch instead of a set of two, recalculate the quantity and subtotal before comparing it with another seller. A superficially unchanged item price can represent a different value when the number of pieces changes.
corrections.translation: 如果商品仍在候选清单，按今天的条件重新判断即可，不需要把它当订单争议。把新选项作为带日期的独立观察，比较总价、组成与尺寸，决定继续、替换还是放弃。保留旧记录能说明上次为什么将它列为候选。

corrections.source: If a selector remains ambiguous, leave the purchase pending while you investigate. A product note saying “send the old version” does not give the seller the old stock or guarantee that an agent can select it. Ask whether the precise old version is available and how to identify it in the current order flow. Preserve any answer with the date. If the response points to a different listing, treat it as a new source and check the actual option text on that listing.
corrections.translation: 若选择框仍不清楚，先暂缓下单。留言“请发老版本”不能让卖家凭空有旧库存，也未必改变当前所选规格。请卖家确认现在该点哪一项能得到想要的版本，并保存针对该组合的书面答复。

corrections.source: Handle a change after payment
corrections.translation: 付款后页面有变怎么办

corrections.source: A practical support message can say that your paid order shows a large olive pouch with a detachable strap, while the current page describes green B without specifying a strap. Ask which version was purchased for your order and whether the strap is included. Provide the dated order reference privately and attach the relevant excerpts. If the answer depends on checking the incoming unit, record that as the next step and decide which warehouse photograph or contents check would settle the issue.
corrections.translation: 可向客服说明：“已付款订单是橄榄绿大号收纳袋，含可拆肩带；当前页面叫绿色 B，没有写肩带。请按原订单确认实际到仓的版本和配件。”私下附订单编号、旧选项及入库资料，便于对方查到具体的一件。

corrections.source: Update shared finds without erasing the history
corrections.translation: 更新分享记录时保留历史

corrections.source: If you share findings with others, keep the original dated note and add an update. Explain the particular change you observed and what you have yet to confirm. For example, the old label disappeared and the listing now offers green A and green B, while the correspondence with the former size remains unknown. A reader can then decide whether your older warehouse album is useful for the shape of the pouch or too uncertain for their current option decision.
corrections.translation: 分享给别人时，不要覆盖旧笔记；在原日期后添加更新，写清观察到什么变化、还欠什么确认。例如注明选项已改名但内部尺寸尚未核实。读者就能判断你的旧推荐是否仍符合当前需求。

corrections.source: After a received unit is photographed, connect its observations to the paid selection and any approved substitution. Do not promote one order's outcome into a promise that every purchase from the edited listing will receive the same version. If the new option works for your own purpose, state the feature that made it acceptable and retain the related evidence. A future buyer may value a different detail and will be able to judge whether your dated comparison answers their question.
corrections.translation: 拍到实物后，把观察与已付选项及双方同意的替换方案对应起来。一次订单的结果不能保证以后从这条改过的出品下单都会收到同版。如果新选项满足你的用途，写清起作用的特征并保留照片；下一位买家重视的可能是另一项细节。
